title: A solution that absorbs half the light per centimetre
caption: Each centimetre of the solution passes half of the light that reaches it, so the fraction through x cm is I/I₀ = 0.5^x = e^{−αx} with α = ln 2 = 0.693 cm⁻¹. After 3 cm: 0.5³ = 0.125 = 12.5%.
alt: Graph of transmitted fraction against path length from 0 to 4 centimetres: an exponential decay through 0.5 at 1 cm, 0.25 at 2 cm and 0.125 at 3 cm.
description: The horizontal axis is the path length in centimetres; the vertical axis is the fraction of light transmitted.
The curve is e^{−αx} with α = ln 2 per cm, equal to 0.5^x.
At 1 cm the fraction is 0.5, at 2 cm 0.25 and at 3 cm 0.5³ = 0.125: 12.5% gets through.
